about: The pins the 2 desktop installers read: install-macos.sh (each tool's 'macos' entry) and install.ps1
(each tool's 'windows_x64' entry, the tool's 'version' when the entry has none, and 'freerouting').
Each URL and each SHA256 is named here only (tests/test_install_macos.py holds this), except the
FreeRouting jar's SHA256, which install.sh names too and the test holds equal.
Each 'source' says where the value was read on 2026-11-27. A 'hashed' source means: the file was
streamed from that URL through sha256sum on Linux, never saved, never run.

macos.source: kicad.org/download/macos (version, macOS 12 and newer); hashed from the url; the same SHA256 in Homebrew's cask kicad (formulae.brew.sh/api/cask/kicad.json); the folder is the cask's suite artifact

windows_x64.source: downloads.kicad.org/kicad/windows/explore/stable; hashed from the url; the same SHA256 and the user switch in winget-pkgs manifests/k/KiCad/KiCad/10.0.8/KiCad.KiCad.installer.yaml (x64, Scope user)

sourceforge.net/projects/ngspice/files/ng-spice-rework/47/ (the sha256 the page lists, read 2026-11-27); the archive it served hashed to the same SHA256 and names Spice64/bin/ngspice_con.exe; the macOS version from formulae.brew.sh/api/formula/ngspice.json (stable 47)

java.source: Eclipse Temurin 21 JRE: api.adoptium.net/v3/assets/latest/21/hotspot?image_type=jre (link, checksum and size of each package)

freerouting.source: install.sh's FREEROUTING_SHA256; hashed again from the url

windows_x64.source: python.org/downloads/release/python-31210 (Windows installer, 64-bit; the page gives no SHA256, only sigstore); hashed from the url; winget-pkgs manifests/p/Python/Python/3/12/3.12.10/Python.Python.3.12.installer.yaml, x64 Scope user; InstallLauncherAllUsers=0 because python/cpython v3.12.10 Tools/msi/bundle/bundle.wxs:31 defaults it to -1 and packagegroups/launcher.wxs installs launcher_AllUsers per machine when it is set
www.7-zip.org/download.html links this 7zr.exe for 7-Zip 26.06 (2026-11-06); the SHA256 is of the 600064-byte file that URL served on 2026-11-27 (the page gives none)

homebrew.source: brew.sh, the command on its front page; min_macos is MACOS_OLDEST_SUPPORTED="15.0" in that install.sh (raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh, read 2026-11-27), which on an Intel Mac aborts: "Homebrew on macOS is only supported on Apple Silicon processors!"
